posts.headline: Put it in Ra sits 0-2 and the crack-turned-canyon-turned-crater is now a full sinkhole for One Nut Barner's league-best 20-8, 1.5-average-finish pedigree.
posts.detail: A franchise with a 0.714 career win rate and back-to-back top-2 finishes is now tied for the worst record in the league at 0-2 — this isn't variance anymore, it's an identity crisis.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0 and I'm STILL waiting to be impressed — 263.62 points is respectable, but a reigning champ's manager should be running away with weeks, not just surviving them.
posts.detail: One ring and a 5.5 average finish means the pedigree owes this league more than a middling scoring pace; 2-0 is nice, but so was 1-0 for three straight editions before this.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-2 with a league-worst 165.84 points, and Auntie Thomas's bottom-feeder résumé just keeps writing itself.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and a 10th-place average finish set the bar low, and somehow this start is finding a way to limbo under it.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and this column has now said it three straight editions — at what point does someone else in this league notice?
posts.detail: triciagloston's 344.18 points is nearly 50 more than the next-closest team, and a 6-7-1 career record never saw this coming.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finally lost, and the untalented tenth's smoke-and-mirrors act is finally getting exposed at 1-1.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and dead-last 12th average finish were always going to catch up to a team scoring in the bottom half of the league — 215.08 points on the season just doesn't hold up.
